title: Distance in the discrete metric

prereqs.why: This is the discrete metric, and the point is that it ignores everything you know about the numbers.

statement:
Let $X = \R$ with the **discrete metric**

$$d(x,y) = \begin{cases} 0 & x = y \\ 1 & x \ne y. \end{cases}$$

Work out

$$d(0, 1000) + d(7, 7) + d(-2, -2.0) + d\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}, 0.333\right).$$
hints: The discrete metric asks one question about a pair of points, and it is not *how far apart are they*. It is *are they the same point*.
Three of the four terms need you to decide whether two expressions name the same real number. Two of them do.
$-2$ and $-2.0$ are the same real number written twice. $\tfrac13$ and $0.333$ are not.

payload.prompt: The sum of the four distances.
payload.label: The sum
payload.syntax: A number. Arithmetic is fine: 1+1 is read as 2.
